svg.title: Batangas City map outline
svg.desc: North-up boundary of Batangas City, including Verde Island. Derived from NAMRIA and PSA boundaries through OCHA COD-AB, via James Faeldon's Philippines JSON Maps, PSGC 3Q 2026.
svg.metadata: Source: https://github.com/faeldon/philippines-json-maps/blob/bf7060598ff5a5d160917f1dcb9622dbaef85ff7/latest/geojson/provdists/medres/municities-provdist-401000000.0.01.json Feature: Batangas City; PSGC 0401005000; geo_level City. Source release: PSGC 3Q 2026; repository commit bf7060598ff5a5d160917f1dcb9622dbaef85ff7, 2026-10-28. Underlying boundary attribution: National Mapping and Resource Information Authority (NAMRIA) and Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), through OCHA's Philippines COD-AB. Boundary license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 IGO (CC BY 3.0 IGO), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/igo/ Boundary dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-phl Changes: selected the Batangas City feature from the medium-resolution GeoJSON; retained both mainland and Verde Island; converted longitude/latitude to a local north-up equirectangular SVG using the midpoint-latitude longitude scale; applied visual styling and coordinate rounding.
